 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 05-12-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 409,
406, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per prosecution case, this petitioner along with other F.I.R. named accused persons committed forgery by misappropriation of fund of Rs. 6,83,788/- out of Rs. 12,90,9000/- in the name of work to be done under the Mukhya Mantri Nal Jal Nischay Yojana.

entities.text: Mukhya Mantri Nal Jal Nischay Yojana
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
At the relevant time, petitioner was Chairman of the aforesaid Yojana and no money has been withdrawn by him with regard to the Patna High Court CR.
It is further submitted that after lodging of the F.I.R., work in question has already been completed.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
He submits that inspite of several opportunities granted by BDO, work has not been completed.
